planets.name: Qatar-2 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Qatar-2 with a 1.34-day year, found in 2011.

text.card: Qatar-2 b was found in 2011 by Qatar as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Qatar-2. Its orbit and size follow Mancini et al. 2014's fit, the archive's default.
